pages.title: CA Client Abstraction
pages.purpose: Explain the CaClient interface and its two implementations: the online HTTP client from smallstep/certificates and the in-process OfflineCA used by --offline.
instructions: Describe OfflineCA as a singleton wrapping authority.Authority with no network.
Document NewClient/NewAdminClient/NewUnauthenticatedAdminClient and root/fingerprint trust resolution.

pages.title: STEPPATH Environment and Contexts
pages.purpose: Document the on-disk state model: STEPPATH layout, defaults.json, ca.json, root_ca.crt, contexts.json, profiles, and how commands resolve flags from them.
instructions: Base all file paths and behavior on the cli-utils step package usage seen in the code, plus bootstrap.go writes.
Cover context add/save-current/remove semantics including shared authority/profile cleanup in remove.go.

pages.title: Architecture Overview
pages.purpose: Explain how the step binary is assembled: urfave/cli app construction, init()-based command registration, plugin dispatch, version injection, and error handling.
instructions: Cover the plugin LookPath/Run mechanism and STEPDEBUG/panic handling in internal/cmd/root.go.
Describe the command registry flow: init() -> command.Register -> command.Retrieve() -> cli.App.Commands.

pages.title: Provisioners and One-Time Tokens
pages.purpose: Explain the provisioner model, token types, token audiences, claim construction, and the NewTokenFlow dispatch across provisioner kinds.
instructions: Cover ParseInsecure payload typing for JWK/OIDC/AWS/GCP/Azure/K8sSA in token/parse.go.
Cover token audiences per type, default validity bounds, JWK kid/issuer handling, and confirmation (cnf) claims.

pages.title: Change Guide: Adding a Command
pages.purpose: Focused guide for adding a new subcommand: registration, flags, action wiring, validation helpers, and tests.
instructions: Use command.ActionFunc and Register patterns; show flag validation with cli-utils errs helpers; reference existing tests.

pages.title: Change Guide: Modifying Certificate Flows
pages.purpose: Focused guide for changing certificate issuance/renewal behavior across online and offline paths, with test locations.
instructions: Explain where online vs offline paths diverge and which tests exercise them.

pages.title: Provisioner and Admin Management API
pages.purpose: Document step ca provisioner, admin, and policy commands: AdminClient usage, linkedca protobuf objects, config-file fallback, and webhooks.
instructions: Cover newCRUDClient fallback from Admin API to config file editing, and admin cert/key credentials generation.

pages.title: OAuth Flows
pages.purpose: Document step oauth: authorization code and device flows used to mint OIDC provisioning tokens, and its integration with token flows.
instructions: Focus on how generateOIDCToken invokes step oauth with provider/client-id/scopes, and the console/bare modes.

pages.title: Debugging and Error Handling
pages.purpose: Document error propagation, STEPDEBUG behavior, panic handling, exit codes, and common failure modes across the CLI.
instructions: Cover the messenger error interface, STEPDEBUG output, panicHandler, and errs flag-validation helpers used throughout.

pages.title: KMS and Plugin Integration
pages.purpose: Document KMS URI handling, step-kms-plugin dispatch, YubiKey/PKCS11/TPM/cloud KMS usage, and attestation flows.
instructions: Cover CreateSigner/LoadJSONWebKey/LoadCertificate delegation to step-kms-plugin subprocess, and the sign digest protocol.
Cover KMS URI format and attestation flows.

pages.title: ACME Protocol Flows
pages.purpose: Document ACME-DA flows: token generation errors for ACME provisioners, standalone/webroot challenge modes, and external ACME CAs.
instructions: Cover ACMETokenError routing, standalone and webroot challenge servers, and EAB flag support.

pages.title: CA Initialization and Bootstrap
pages.purpose: Document step ca init (PKI generation, deployment types, RA modes, KMS) and step ca bootstrap (root download, defaults.json, team bootstrap).
instructions: Document bootstrap root download via fingerprint, defaults.json writing, and truststore install.
Document flag-compatibility validation, deployment types, CloudCAS/StepCAS RA branches, and pki.New option assembly.

pages.title: Certificate Issuance
pages.purpose: Document step ca certificate and step ca sign end-to-end: token generation, CSR creation, SAN handling, key generation, offline mode, and response writing.
instructions: Describe CreateSignRequest SAN logic per token type including AWS/GCP/Azure/OIDC defaults.
Describe flow.Sign writing the PEM chain and key serialization.

pages.title: Certificate Renewal, Rekey and Revocation
pages.purpose: Document step ca renew (mTLS vs X5C token, daemon loop, pid/signal/exec hooks), rekey, and revoke (token vs mTLS, reason codes).
instructions: Cover passive revocation only (no CRL/OCSP), serial validation, and reason code mapping.
Cover renewer internals: TLS transport setup, RenewWithToken X5C headers, nextRenewDuration jitter, daemon signal loop.

pages.title: Offline X.509 Operations
pages.purpose: Document the step certificate command group for creating, signing, verifying, inspecting, and fingerprinting X.509 certs without a CA, including templates and profiles.
instructions: Cover profiles (leaf/root-ca/intermediate-ca/self-signed/csr), default templates and validity durations, and template data via --set/--set-file.
Cover verify path validation, OCSP and CRL verification flows.

pages.title: SSH Certificate Workflows
pages.purpose: Document the step ssh command group: certificate creation, login/logout, SSH agent interaction, config, proxy-command, and host checks.
instructions: Cover loginOnUnauthorized retry flow, identity CSR, agent add/remove, and createPrincipalsFromSubject.
Cover ssh agent dialing in internal/sshutil and includes file behavior.

pages.title: Quickstart
pages.purpose: Practical onboarding: build/test the binary, initialize a CA, get a certificate, and locate the generated STEPPATH artifacts.
instructions: Describe STEPPATH artifacts (ca.json, defaults.json, root_ca.crt) as created by the code, not from external docs.
Ground every command sequence in actual flags and defaults from command/ca/init.go, command/ca/certificate.go, and internal/cmd/root.go.
